contracts.py.decision: retain generic values; remove Linear team/issue fields, legacy command ID, Answer/callback/AI receipt translation
contracts.py.reason: Repository configuration and exact task/input bindings are distinct; no competing provider or notification authority.

git_profile.py.decision: retain confinement; add immutable trusted target/repository/profile enrollment
git_profile.py.reason: Generic transport must not default to one project branch or accept a target from request data.

local_git.py.decision: retain actual CAS/fast-forward, expected-old transaction, reflog observation, process gate and output draining
local_git.py.reason: These are project-neutral publication safeguards, independently exercised in authored repositories.

journal.py.decision: retain transaction/version/idempotency history; remove callback writer and retire old schema without conversion
journal.py.reason: Publication persistence owns no task/provider/AI state; historical stores remain preserved and explicitly refused.

registrations.py.decision: combine registration with the single publication consumer
registrations.py.reason: Trusted scope checks belong before intent/effects and historical readback; no duplicate adapter registration authority.

operations.py.decision: replace script-stage emulation with exact candidate/check-ref preparation and publisher delegation
operations.py.reason: No placeholder script runner, model lifetime controller, test selector or database state translator belongs to Git publication.

callbacks.py.decision: retire; do not move or alias legacy landed/branch_note/local_db/pipeline/release stages
callbacks.py.reason: Provider, human acceptance and AI/public receipts keep their existing owners; removing duplicate component tests is not acceptance of pending integration.
callbacks.py.replacement_path: existing application notification/provider services; integration pending

__init__.py.decision: retire old namespace; no re-export bridge
__init__.py.reason: Actual wheel/import checks must fail discovery of the removed namespace.

boundaries: trusted target comes only from enrolled profile; request target field rejected
two unrelated authored repositories, refs/heads/trunk and refs/heads/release/next, same consumer
both compare-and-swap and checked-out fast-forward for both targets
wrong repository/worktree/configuration digest rejected before effect
changed/re-enrolled target cannot borrow a durable intent
invalid target refs and cross-repository request refused
no old namespace import or alias in built wheel
domain imports no adapter/application/storage; transport no task/provider policy
actual include guard before repository-aware query remains
exact expected-old CAS, checked commit and source ref binding
durable intent before physical Git child release
committed replay after current profile drift returns historical fact without new effect
lost reply remains uncertain/reconciled, never duplicate launch
active/unknown process ownership and large output retained
atomic persistence, idempotency/version conflicts and foreign/old journal refusal
retired callback translators cannot be imported; no arbitrary command execution API

test_dispositions.old outer-model/database lifetime tests: duplicate emulation retired; actual supervisor/resource lifecycle remains required and pending elsewhere
